inputs.request: Read-only state-trace simulation. Emit only canonical state:<state>|owner:<canonical owner>|output:<observable output> events with no prose, using only accepted, ready, running, handed-off, verifying, verified, reviewing, reviewed, and complete in causal order. Use only owner tokens backend, worker, dev-verification, and dev-code-review; curation is terminal evidence in complete, never another task or state. Scenario: a settled compact task satisfies every compact eligibility condition and declares one Learning Candidate with a complete deterministic Evaluation proposal. Its approved Task Contract binds one implementation owner, same non-implementer identity for ordered verifier/reviewer attempts, and qualifying-trigger-only curation. Before curator dispatch the backend validates the reporter proposal, freezes its exact source and independent adjacent cases plus expectations and proof, and binds CE-COMPACT-1 @ canonical SHA-256 in Task Contract Verification and the Context Pack. The backend must dispatch bounded dev-continual-learning after review, account for CURATED only after both deterministic post-runs pass without a separate evaluator, and never create a new curation outcome or lifecycle state.
